name: Toggle button
summary: A button that stays switched on or off, shown by aria-pressed, alone or in a toggle group.
description: Use it for an on or off setting that takes effect at once, such as Pin, Bold or a column being shown. Vectra styles the pressed state; your script flips aria-pressed on click. For a setting in a form, use a switch.

classes.name: v-toggle-group
classes.description: A padded tray for a row of toggle buttons that switch on and off independently. Buttons inside lose their own border and fill.

states.description: Switched on: accent tint and a doubled accent border, so it does not rest on colour alone.
Switched off: the normal button style. Set it explicitly so screen readers know it is a toggle.

keyboard.action: Switches it on or off (your click handler flips aria-pressed).

a11y: Keep the label the same in both states; screen readers announce "pressed" or "not pressed" for you. Changing the label as well reads twice.
Put role="group" and an aria-label on a .v-toggle-group.
In forced colours mode the pressed button fills with the system Highlight colour.

examples.title: Single toggles
Toggle group

hooks.name: data-v-toggle
hooks.on: a button with aria-pressed, or any container of them
hooks.description: Flips aria-pressed on click (Enter and Space work natively). With "single", at most one button in the container stays pressed.

events.name: v:change
events.description: Fires after the pressed state flips.
